{{Quote|I was twelve. His name was Palo. We were both in the Legislative Youth Program. He was a few years older than I… very cute… dark curly hair… dreamy eyes.|Padmé Amidala, to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="AOC" />}}
'''Palo Jemabie''' was a [[Gender|male]] from [[Naboo]]. As a teenager, he was involved in the [[Legislative Youth Program]] alongside [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], with whom he fell in love. The two ended their relationship when Jemabie became an [[artist]], while Amidala pursued a career in [[politics]]. After the [[Galactic Republic]] was [[Proclamation of the New Order|replaced]] by the [[Galactic Empire]], Jemabie was sentenced to a [[labor camp]] before eventually joining the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Due to his allegiance to the Rebellion, he was abducted by the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] before the [[Battle of Jakku|end]] of the [[Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
[[File:Naboo_Corronation.png|thumb|left|200px|The poster ''Naboo Coronation'']]
A dark, curly-[[hair]]ed<ref name="AOC" /> [[Gender|male]],<ref name="Trivia Gallery" /> Palo Jemabie [[Homeworld|hailed]] from the [[planet]] [[Naboo]].<ref name="Propaganda" /><ref name="AOC" /> He<ref name="AOC" /> was [[Reproduction|born]] a few [[Standard year|years]] before [[46 BBY]].<ref name="Birth" /> As a teenager, Jemabie participated in the [[Legislative Youth Program]], where he met a twelve-year-old girl named [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Naberrie]]. The two had a brief relationship, but ultimately parted ways when Jemabie elected to become an [[artist]], while Naberrie began a career in the [[Politics|public service]].<ref name="AOC" />

When Naberrie was elected [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen of Naboo]] at age fourteen under the regnal name of Amidala, Jemabie created a [[Painting|poster]] entitled ''[[Naboo Coronation]]'', inviting the [[Naboo (people)|Naboo]] to the [[Coronation of Queen Amidala|inauguration]] of their new monarch that was set to take place on the 34th of [[Grizm]], 835th [[Naboo calendar|Year of Kwilaan]].<ref name="Propaganda" />

Shortly before the [[First Battle of Geonosis|onslaught]] of the [[Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY]], Amidala spoke fondly of her young romance with Jemabie to her future [[Marriage|husband]], the [[Padawan|Jedi apprentice]] [[Anakin Skywalker]]. As they were sharing a moment in the idyllic [[Lake Country|countryside]] of Naboo, Amidala reminisced about her first love in detail, prompting Skywalker to react with mild jealousy.<ref name="AOC" />

At the conclusion of the Clone Wars in [[19 BBY]], the [[Democracy|democratic]] [[Galactic Republic]] was [[Proclamation of the New Order|replaced]] by the [[Galactic Empire]], an [[Dictatorship|authoritarian]] regime created by [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]], former [[Supreme Chancellor]] of the Republic.<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref> During the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of Palpatine's [[New Order]], Jemabie was arrested by the [[Coalition for Progress]] on the charge of a deviant musical performance and sentenced to work in a [[labor camp]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire">''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]''</ref> After achieving his freedom, he allied himself with the anti-Imperial [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]], using his skills as an artist to create posters for the resistance movement. The Naboo artist, however, would be captured and disappeared by the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] before the [[Battle of Jakku|end]] of the [[Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Propaganda" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:RushClovis-SWE.png|thumb|right|200px|Rush Clovis was created to replace Palo Jemabie as Padmé Amidala's love interest in "Senate Spy"]]
Palo was first mentioned in the [[2002]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], the second installment in the [[prequel trilogy]] of ''[[Star Wars]]''.<ref name="AOC" />

<nowiki> </nowiki>He was originally set to return as Amidala's love interest in "[[Senate Spy]]," the fourth episode in [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|season two]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, but this idea was abandoned early on when the crew remembered that Palo had left politics to become an artist. The show's creators also felt that the relationship between Amidala and the "Senate Spy" character needed to be more recent than the one between her and Palo, so that the theme of Anakin Skywalker's jealousy would be better supported. Palo's role as love interest was thus assumed by a new character, [[Rush Clovis]].<ref name="Trivia Gallery" />

In his [[2016]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Propaganda: A History of Persuasive Art in the Galaxy]]'', [[Pablo Hidalgo]] gave Palo the last name "Jemabie" and slightly expanded on his biography.<ref name="Propaganda" />
